title: EvalCase
description: One labeled test case in the eval suite (see ../evaluation/EVAL_SUITE.md). Covers all three tiers: component (single agent, labeled expectation), trajectory (assertion over a run log), and system (full replay). Cases are versioned data, kept outside the KB and excluded from retrieval so evals measure capability rather than memorization.

target.description: What is under test: agent name (intake_analyst, kb_mapper, claim_auditor, ingestion_agent…), or 'pipeline' for system cases.

suite.description: Named set this case belongs to, e.g. poison_set, anonymization_set, mapper_retrieval, adversarial_structures.

held_out.description: true = never used for prompt tuning. Keep ≥20% of every suite held out permanently.

input.description: The case input. Reference files by path rather than inlining large documents.

generator.description: Runtime fixture builder ('module:function' under engine.*) the harness invokes to create input.files[0] in the case workdir. Exists because committed binaries are barred by the tripwire's extraction sweep (B40/D21): media cases (C11 logo/signature docx) generate at run time.

kb_snapshot.description: Frozen KB version this case is scored against — the engine must be the only variable across runs.

kb_excluded.description: kb_ids withheld for this case. Eval hygiene: the answer must not be retrievable.

expected.description: Ground truth. Component cases carry labels; trajectory cases carry assertions; system cases carry the human-submitted reference.

labels.description: e.g. correct card kb_ids, required requirement-matrix entries, identifiers that must be anonymized.

claim_truth.description: Poison-set cases: what the Claim Auditor should conclude.

must_flag.description: The engine is required to raise a gap/flag rather than produce prose.

must_not_contain.description: Strings whose presence in output is an automatic fail — leaked client names, fees, reference contacts.

must_flag.description: C11: the ingest report must carry the media flag for this document (an embedded logo/signature image is identity the text scan cannot see).

reference_output.description: Path to the human-submitted or golden output for similarity scoring.

trajectory_assertions.description: Trajectory tier: assertions evaluated against the run log rather than the output.

bar.description: Pass threshold for this case or its suite.

blocking.description: true = failing this blocks release with no waiver path (fabricated-Tier-1 recall, anonymization recall).

rubric_id.description: Which rubric version the judge used — rubrics are versioned; scores across rubric versions are not comparable.

judge_model.description: Judge scores are only comparable within the same judge model. A judge change invalidates the historical series until recalibrated.

synthetic.description: true for adversarial/constructed cases (poison claims, injected contradictions, synthetic structures).
